In the context of file deletion, what is the typical immediate effect of moving a file to the 'Trash' or 'Recycle Bin' in a GUI-based Operating System?

options.text: The file is moved to a special directory, and its directory entry is updated, but the data remains on the storage device.
The file's data is immediately overwritten and unrecoverable.
The file's metadata (inode or equivalent) is immediately purged from the file system.
The file is compressed and archived before being permanently deleted.

questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**The file is moved to a special directory, and its directory entry is updated, but the data remains on the storage device.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When a file is moved to the **'Trash' or 'Recycle Bin'** in a **GUI-based Operating System**, it is not permanently deleted.
 
• The file’s **directory entry** is updated to reflect its new location in a special directory (e.g., the Trash or Recycle Bin folder).
 
• The actual **data remains on the storage device** until the file is permanently deleted or the storage space is overwritten.
 
• This mechanism allows users to **recover deleted files** easily if they change their minds or deleted the file by mistake.
 
• The Trash or Recycle Bin acts as a **, ensuring the file is not lost immediately and providing an opportunity for restoration.
 
• This functionality is common in operating systems like Windows, macOS, and Linux GUIs**, making file management more user-friendly and less prone to accidental data loss.
 
• Files in the Trash or Recycle Bin typically still occupy **storage space** until they are permanently deleted or the Trash/Recycle Bin is emptied.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The file’s data is immediately overwritten and unrecoverable.**__

 __
 
• This is incorrect because simply moving a file to the Trash or Recycle Bin does not overwrite the data. Overwriting occurs only when specific tools or processes overwrite the storage sectors.
 
• Overwriting makes data recovery nearly impossible, but this is not the default behavior of the Trash/Recycle Bin feature.
 
 
 
• **The file’s metadata (inode or equivalent) is immediately purged from the file system.**__
 __
 
• When a file is moved to the Trash or Recycle Bin, its metadata is not purged immediately. Instead, its location is updated, and the metadata is preserved for potential recovery.
 
• Metadata purging occurs during permanent deletion or when the file system explicitly removes all references to the file.
 
 
 
• **The file is compressed and archived before being permanently deleted.**__
 
 
• Trash/Recycle Bin does not compress or archive files by default. Files retain their original format and size while in the Trash/Recycle Bin.
 
• Compression is a separate process, often used in backup solutions, not for managing deleted files in most operating systems.

questions.question: There are two sections A and B of a class, consisting of 22 and 44 students, respectively. If the average weight of section A is 40 kg and that of section B is 34 kg, find the average weight of the whole class (in kg).
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of student counts in **Section A** and **Section B** = 22 : 44 = **1 : 2**.

Using the **ratio method** for weighted average: [(1 × 40) + (2 × 34)] ÷ (1 + 2).

Combined **average weight** = (40 + 68) ÷ 3 = 108 ÷ 3 = **36 kg**.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 kg.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Students in **Section A** (n₁) = 22 | Average weight (x₁) = 40 kg

Students in **Section B** (n₂) = 44 | Average weight (x₂) = 34 kg

**Formula Used:**

Average weight of the class = (Sum of weights of all students) ÷ (Total number of students)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aef65a95014fa23fc3c3ac86ef7d000663418457847ffbdef40fe68dbe65845.png] 
⇒ Total weight of **Section A** = 22 × 40 = 880 kg
⇒ Total weight of **Section B** = 44 × 34 = 1496 kg
⇒ **Total class weight** = 880 + 1496 = 2376 kg
⇒ **Total class strength** = 22 + 44 = 66
⇒ **Average weight** of the **whole class** = 2376 ÷ 66 = 36 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 36 kg.**

**__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

When two groups are combined, the total average is calculated as (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Ratio Simplification

For average weight or score calculations, you can replace actual quantities with their **simplest ratio** to reduce numerical complexity.

Deviation Method

Pick an **assumed average** and calculate the net deviation. The final average is Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Total Count).</p

questions.question: Walking at (2)/(5) of his normal speed, Abhijeet is 48 minutes late in reaching. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his destination is?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__
When **Distance** is constant, **Speed** is inversely proportional to **Time**.

Speed ratio = 5 : 2 → Time ratio = 2 : 5.

Difference in time units = 5 − 2 = 3 units.

Given 3 units = 48 minutes ⇒ 1 unit = 16 minutes.

Usual time = 2 units = 2 × 16 = 32 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 32 min.**

**__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0483dca697f5d885c901ef3fbe2fccbd7032533767e680f9524e79df88f23ce2.png] 
**Given:** New speed = 2/5 of Normal speed. Delay = 48 minutes.

**Formula:** Usual Time = [Late time × Numerator] ÷ [Denominator − Numerator]

⇒ Let normal speed be S and usual time be T.

⇒ New speed = (2/5) × S

⇒ Since Distance = Speed × Time, S × T = (2/5)S × (T + 48)

⇒ T = (2/5) × (T + 48)

⇒ 5T = 2T + 96

⇒ 3T = 96

⇒ T = 32 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 32 min.**

**__Additional Information__**

Inverse Relationship of Speed and Time

If distance is constant, Speed₁/Speed₂ = Time₂/Time₁. This is the foundation for solving **constant distance** problems.

Direct Shortcut for Late/Early Problems

If a person travels at a/b of their usual speed and is 'L' minutes late, Usual Time = (a × L) ÷ |b − a|.

Average Speed for Constant Distance

When a person travels to a destination and back at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).</p

questions.question: Two concentric circles have radii of 10 cm and 26 cm. Find the length of the chord of the larger circle that is tangent to the smaller circle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **concentric circles**, the length of the **chord** of the larger circle that is **tangent** to the smaller circle is given by:

Length of chord = 2 × √(R² − r²)

Where R = 26 cm and r = 10 cm.

⇒ Length = 2 × √(26² − 10²) = 2 × √(676 − 100)

⇒ Length = 2 × √576 = 2 × 24 = 48 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the larger circle (R) = 26 cm

Radius of the smaller circle (r) = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

In a **right-angled triangle**, Pythagoras theorem states: Hypotenuse² = Base² + Perpendicular²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/076a612dbba0d906778c406993fb63ecb600b4c9abefabe8304b1731c2f0318a.png] 

Let the two **concentric circles** have a common center O.

Let AB be the **chord** of the larger circle which is **tangent** to the smaller circle at point M.

Since OM is the radius of the smaller circle and AB is the tangent, OM ⊥ AB.

⇒ In right-angled ▵OMA, OA = 26 cm (Radius of larger circle) and OM = 10 cm (Radius of smaller circle).

Using **Pythagoras theorem** in ▵OMA:

⇒ OA² = OM² + AM²

⇒ 26² = 10² + AM²

⇒ 676 = 100 + AM²

⇒ AM² = 676 − 100 = 576

⇒ AM = √576 = 24 cm

Since the perpendicular from the center to a chord **bisects** the chord:

⇒ AB = 2 × AM = 2 × 24 = 48 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Concentric Circles

Circles that share the same center but have different radii are called concentric circles.

Tangent-Radius Property

The radius of a circle is always perpendicular to the tangent at the point of contact (OM ⊥ AB).

Chord Bisector Theorem

A perpendicular drawn from the center of a circle to a chord bisects the chord into two equal parts.</p

questions.question: Raj has ₹1,218 with him. He divided it amongst his sons Varun and Ashish and asked them to invest it at 10% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. It was seen that Varun and Ashish got the same amount after 13 and 14 years, respectively. How much (in ₹) did Raj give to Ashish?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of shares is determined by the **time difference**: 14 − 13 = 1 year.

At **10% rate**, the multiplying factor is (1 + 10/100) = 11/10.

Ratio of **Varun's share : Ashish's share** = (11/10)¹ : 1 = 11 : 10.

Total units = 11 + 10 = 21 units → **₹1,218**.

Value of 1 unit = 1,218 ÷ 21 = ₹58.

Ashish's share = 10 units × 58 = **₹580**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹580.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Amount = **₹1,218**

Rate (R) = **10% per annum**

Time for **Varun** (Tv) = **13 years**

Time for **Ashish** (Tₐ) = **14 years**

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a2606a6336c53f06a009584e8164f4e77c21cf90ef1139ad45200aa79f7a7a5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Amount for Varun = Amount for Ashish

⇒ Pv(1 + 10/100)¹³ = Pₐ(1 + 10/100)¹⁴

⇒ Pv × (1.1)¹³ = Pₐ × (1.1)¹⁴

⇒ Pv / Pₐ = (1.1)¹⁴ ÷ (1.1)¹³

⇒ Pv / Pₐ = 1.1 = 11 / 10

⇒ Ratio of shares Pv : Pₐ = 11 : 10

⇒ Ashish's share = [10 ÷ (11 + 10)] × 1,218

⇒ Ashish's share = (10 ÷ 21) × 1,218

⇒ Ashish's share = 10 × 58 = 580

**∴ The correct answer is ₹580.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Amount Formula

The total amount A after n years is given by A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ, where P is the principal and r is the annual interest rate.

Ratio of Principals for Equal Amounts

If amounts are equal after T₁ and T₂ years, the ratio of principals is P₁/P₂ = (1 + r/100)⁽T² − T¹⁾.

Compound Interest (CI)

The interest earned is CI = A − P = P[(1 + r/100)ⁿ − 1].

questions.question: What special status did the Sixty-ninth Amendment Act, 1991 give to Delhi?

options.text: Designated Delhi as the National Capital Territory with a legislative assembly
Brought Delhi under the control of the President through the Governor
Made Delhi a Union Territory without a legislature

questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Designated Delhi as the National Capital Territory with a legislative assembly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sixty-ninth Amendment Act, 1991** granted Delhi the status of a **National Capital Territory (NCT).**
 
• This amendment enabled Delhi to have its own **legislative assembly** and **Council of Ministers** to manage affairs related to certain subjects.
 
• It introduced **Article 239AA** into the Constitution of India, detailing the structure and functioning of the governance in Delhi.
 
• While Delhi was given a legislative assembly, it remained a **Union Territory**, with its legislative powers limited to specific domains like public order, police, and land under the control of the Union Government.
 
• Delhi's governance is unique as it has a blend of both the **Union Government** and a locally elected assembly, making it distinct from full-fledged states.
 
• The amendment aimed to strike a balance between Delhi's status as the **capital city** and granting it some degree of self-governance.
 
• The Chief Minister of Delhi is the head of the elected government, but the **Lieutenant Governor** retains significant powers and represents the Union Government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Brought Delhi under the control of the President through the Governor**__

 __
 
• Delhi is governed by the **Lieutenant Governor**, who acts as the representative of the President of India, but it is not directly under the control of a Governor as seen in states.
 
• The **Lieutenant Governor** holds administrative authority and works alongside the elected government.
 
 
 
• **Granted full Statehood to Delhi**__

questions.question: How long (in years) will it take for ₹1,680 to become ₹2,100 at a rate of 4% per annum simple interest?

Total **Interest** earned = ₹2,100 − ₹1,680 = ₹420

**Interest for 1 year** = 4% of ₹1,680 = 16.8 × 4 = ₹67.2

**Number of years (T)** = Total Interest ÷ Interest per year

⇒ T = 420 ÷ 67.2 = 6.25 years

**∴ The correct answer is 6.25 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08c90d699a5cc89ffcbfbf3907be33dccd40a8252b7c37fefd7dd566228efd5d.png] 

⇒ SI = A − P = 2100 − 1680 = ₹420

⇒ 420 = (1680 × 4 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 420 × 100 = 6720 × T

⇒ 42000 = 6720 × T

⇒ T = 4200 ÷ 672

⇒ T = 6.25 years

**∴ The correct answer is 6.25 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is calculated only on the initial **Principal** amount. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Amount in Simple Interest

The total money returned after a period is A = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

Rate of Interest

If Time and Principal are constant, Simple Interest is directly proportional to the **Rate of Interest**.

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 57 hours, B and C together can do it in 28 hours, while A and C together can do it in 19 hours. How long (in hours) will B alone take to do it?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__
**Total Work** (LCM of 57, 28, 19) = 1596 units.

Efficiency of **A** = 1596 ÷ 57 = 28 units/hr.

Efficiency of **A + C** = 1596 ÷ 19 = 84 units/hr → Efficiency of **C** = 84 − 28 = 56 units/hr.

Efficiency of **B + C** = 1596 ÷ 28 = 57 units/hr → Efficiency of **B** = 57 − 56 = 1 unit/hr.

Time taken by **B** = 1596 ÷ 1 = 1596 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 1596 hours.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **A** = 57 hours

Time taken by **B + C** = 28 hours

Time taken by **A + C** = 19 hours

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency**
 **A** 57 1596 28
 **B + C** 28 57
 **A + C** 19 84
**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of **A** = 28

⇒ Efficiency of **A + C** = 84

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = (A + C) − A = 84 − 28 = 56

⇒ Efficiency of **B + C** = 57

⇒ Efficiency of **B** = (B + C) − C = 57 − 56 = 1

⇒ Time taken by **B alone** = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of B

⇒ Time = 1596 ÷ 1 = 1596 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 1596 hours.**

**__Additional Information__**

Combined Efficiency

When multiple people work together, their **individual efficiencies** are added to find the total rate of work per unit time.

Total Work Assumption

Taking the **LCM (Least Common Multiple)** of the given time durations as the total work simplifies calculations by ensuring efficiencies are integers.

Inverse Relationship

For a constant amount of work, **Time** is inversely proportional to **Efficiency** (T ∝ 1/E).</p

questions.question: The median of the observations 87, 56, 79, 81, 11, 53, 94, 45, 32, 99 and 98 is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Arrange the given **11 observations** in **ascending order**:

11, 32, 45, 53, 56, **79**, 81, 87, 94, 98, 99

Since the number of terms (N = 11) is **odd**, the **median** is the exact middle term:

Median = ((11 + 1) ÷ 2)th term = 6th term = **79**

**∴ The correct answer is 79.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 87, 56, 79, 81, 11, 53, 94, 45, 32, 99, 98

Total number of observations (N) = 11

**Formula Used:**

When N is odd, Median = ((N + 1) ÷ 2)th term (after arranging in ascending order).

**Calculations:**

First, arrange the given observations in ascending order:

⇒ 11, 32, 45, 53, 56, 79, 81, 87, 94, 98, 99

Count the total number of observations:

⇒ N = 11

Since N is an odd number, the median is calculated as:

⇒ Median = ((N + 1) ÷ 2)th term

⇒ Median = ((11 + 1) ÷ 2)th term

⇒ Median = (12 ÷ 2)th term

⇒ Median = 6th term

Looking at the ordered list, the 6th term is 79.

⇒ Median = 79

**Option Analysis:**

⇒ **Option (1) 53:** This is the 4th term in the sorted list, not the middle term.

⇒ **Option (2) 56:** This is the 5th term in the sorted list, which is just before the middle term.

⇒ **Option (3) 81:** This is the 7th term in the sorted list, which is just after the middle term.

⇒ **Option (4) 79:** This is the exact 6th (middle) term, which is the correct median.

**∴ The correct answer is 79.**

**__Additional Information__**

Median for Even Number of Terms

If the number of observations (N) is even, the median is the average of the (N ÷ 2)th term and the ((N ÷ 2) + 1)th term after arranging them in ascending order.

Relation between Mean, Median, and Mode

For a moderately skewed distribution, the empirical relationship is: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

Effect of Outliers on Median

Unlike the mean, the median is a robust measure of central tendency and is not heavily influenced by extremely large or small values (outliers).</p

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2020** extended the provision for **reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST)** in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies.
 
• This reservation was originally provided under **Article 334** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Such reservations were introduced for a period of **70 years** starting from the adoption of the Constitution in 1950.
 
• The amendment extended the reservation for SCs and STs by **10 years**, thereby ensuring these provisions until **2030**.
 
• The primary aim of this provision is to ensure **adequate political representation** for marginalized communities in legislative bodies.
 
• The reservation does not apply to seats in the **Rajya Sabha** and **Legislative Councils**, as these are indirectly elected bodies.
 
• It highlights India’s commitment to **social justice** and the inclusion of disadvantaged communities in the political process.

• The reduction of voting age applies to elections for the **Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies**.

 __
 
• The **GST Council** was established under **Article 279A** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It was introduced through the **101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016**.
 
• The Council is responsible for making decisions related to **Goods and Services Tax (GST)**.

• **V.O. Chidambaram Pillai**, also known as "Kappalottiya Tamilan," was a prominent **Indian freedom fighter** and a key figure in the **Swadeshi Movement**.
 
• He was actively involved in the revolutionary movement in the region of **Madras Presidency**, which is now a part of modern-day **Tamil Nadu.**
 
• He was instrumental in establishing the **first indigenous shipping service**, the Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company, to compete with British shipping companies.
 
• V.O. Chidambaram Pillai was deeply influenced by the ideas of **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** and used his entrepreneurial skills to strengthen the **Swadeshi Movement**.
 
• He contributed significantly to the cause of **economic independence** by promoting indigenous industries and creating awareness about the exploitation by colonial powers.
 
• He was arrested by the British authorities in 1908 for his revolutionary activities and was subjected to rigorous imprisonment, including forced labor.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 38?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be divisible by **38**, it must be divisible by its factors **2** and **19**.

Checking options for **divisibility by 2**: (1) 2620, (3) 1938 are even; (2) 2423, (4) 1495 are odd and eliminated.

Check **1938** for **19**: 1900 + 38 = (19 × 100) + (19 × 2) = 19 × 102. It is divisible.

**∴ The correct answer is 1938.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Divisor = **38**

**Method:** Perform direct division for each option to check for **zero remainder**.

⇒ Option (1): 2620 ÷ 38 ≈ 68.94 (Not divisible)

⇒ Option (2): 2423 ÷ 38 ≈ 63.76 (Not divisible)

⇒ Option (3): 1938 ÷ 38

⇒ 1938 ÷ 38 = 51 (Remainder = 0)

⇒ Option (4): 1495 ÷ 38 ≈ 39.34 (Not divisible)

**∴ The correct answer is 1938.**

**__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by Composite Numbers

A number is divisible by a **composite number** if it is divisible by its **co-prime factors**. For 38, factors are 2 and 19.

Divisibility Rule of 19

Multiply the **last digit** by 2 and add it to the **remaining number**. If the result is divisible by 19, the whole number is. Example: 193 + (8 × 2) = 209; 20 + (9 × 2) = 38 (Divisible).

Divisibility Rule of 2

A number is divisible by 2 if its **last digit** is even (0, 2, 4, 6, or 8).</p

questions.question: The Meissner effect is a defining characteristic of which state of matter?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Superconducting state**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Meissner effect** is the phenomenon where a material expels **magnetic fields** when it transitions into the **superconducting state**.
 
• This effect is a defining characteristic of superconductors and demonstrates their ability to exhibit **perfect diamagnetism**.
 
• In the superconducting state, the material's resistance drops to **zero**, allowing electric currents to flow without energy loss.
 
• The effect was discovered in **1933** by Walther Meissner and Robert Ochsenfeld.
 
• It occurs due to the formation of **Cooper pairs**, which are paired electrons that move without scattering.
 
• The Meissner effect is observed below a critical temperature, which varies depending on the type of superconducting material.
 
• The effect is utilized in technologies such as **magnetic levitation** and highly efficient electrical systems.
 
• Superconductors are categorized into two types: **Type I** and **Type II**, both exhibiting the Meissner effect but with different behaviors in external magnetic fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Paramagnetic state**__

 __
 
• In the **paramagnetic state**, materials are weakly attracted to external magnetic fields due to the alignment of magnetic moments.
 
• Unlike the superconducting state, paramagnetic materials do not exhibit **zero resistance** or expulsion of magnetic fields.
 
• Examples of paramagnetic materials include **aluminum**, **platinum**, and **magnesium.**
 
 
 
• **Ferromagnetic state**__
 __
 
• In the **ferromagnetic state**, materials exhibit strong attraction to magnetic fields and retain their magnetization even after the external field is removed.
 
• Examples include **iron**, **nickel**, and **cobalt**.
 
• Ferromagnetic materials are used in applications like **electric motors**, **transformers**, and **permanent magnets**.
 
 
 
• **Insulating state**__
 
 
• In the **insulating state**, materials do not conduct electricity due to the absence of free electrons or charge carriers.
 
• Common examples include **rubber**, **glass**, and **ceramics**.
 
• Insulators are widely used in **electrical wiring** and **circuit components** to prevent current leakage.

questions.question: A person saves 40% of his income. If his expenditure is ₹480, then his income (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Savings** = 40% → **Expenditure** = 100% − 40% = 60%.

60% units = ₹480

1% unit = 480 ÷ 60 = 8

100% (Income) = 8 × 100 = ₹800.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹800.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Savings** = 40% of **Income**

**Expenditure** = ₹480

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c36f8f4af23ccb0585e3c6c4447c85c4371148e86719192c3dd51ce330a51c87.png] 

**Formula:** **Income** = **Expenditure** + **Savings**

⇒ Let total **Income** be ₹I.

⇒ **Savings** = 0.40 × I

⇒ **Expenditure** = I − 0.40I = 0.60I

⇒ 0.60 × I = 480

⇒ I = 480 ÷ 0.60

⇒ I = 48000 ÷ 60

⇒ I = 800

questions.question: 2 men or 9 women can do a job in 14 days. 2 men work for 9 days and leave. The number of women required to complete the remaining work in 9 days is:

Total Work = **2 × 9 × 14 = 252 units**.

Work done by **2 men** in **9 days** = **2 × 9 × 9 = 162 units**.

Remaining Work = **252 − 162 = 90 units**.

Women required (**n**) × Efficiency (**2**) × Days (**9**) = **90** ⇒ **n = 90 ÷ 18 = 5**.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 women.**

questions.question: The diameter of a metallic solid sphere is 42 cm. It is melted and drawn into a wire with a cross-sectional diameter of 0.6 cm. Find the length (in metre) of the wire.

Volume of **sphere** = Volume of **cylindrical wire**

(4/3) × π × R³ = π × r² × L

(4/3) × 21 × 21 × 21 = 0.3 × 0.3 × L (all in cm)

L = (4 × 7 × 21 × 21) ÷ 0.09 = 137200 cm = 1372 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1372 m.**

Diameter of **wire** (d) = 0.6 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 0.3 cm

Volume of **sphere** = (4/3) × π × R³

Volume of **cylinder** (wire) = π × r² × h (where h is the length L)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60bb335a490cbe3da8fbcef57512325b8c1dfaffffc1cc4b24a1ffca1e127c72.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of **sphere** = Volume of **wire**

⇒ (4/3) × π × (21)³ = π × (0.3)² × L

⇒ (4/3) × 21 × 21 × 21 = 0.09 × L

⇒ 4 × 7 × 441 = 0.09 × L

⇒ 12348 = 0.09 × L

⇒ L = 12348 ÷ 0.09 = 137200 cm

⇒ L (in metre) = 137200 ÷ 100 = 1372 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1372 m.**

Volume Invariance

When a solid is **melted** and recast into a new shape, the **total volume** remains constant, provided there is no wastage.

Cylinder Properties

For a **wire** (cylinder), the curved surface area is 2πrh and the total surface area is 2πr(h + r).

questions.question: Which of the following components is NOT part of the CPU?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Hard Disk Drive (HDD)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Hard Disk Drive (HDD)** is a storage device that is not part of the **Central Processing Unit (CPU)**.
 
• The CPU consists of components like the **Control Unit (CU)**, **Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU)**, and **Cache Memory**, which work together to process data and execute instructions.
 
• Unlike the CPU, the HDD is primarily used for **long-term data storage** and does not perform data processing or execution of instructions.
 
• The HDD is considered an **external storage device** connected to the computer system to store files, programs, and operating systems.
 
• HDDs are slower compared to **RAM** or **Cache Memory** when it comes to accessing data, as they are designed for mass storage rather than quick access.
 
• Modern computers often use **Solid State Drives (SSD)** alongside or in place of HDDs due to their faster data access speeds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Cache Memory**__

 __
 
• **Cache Memory** is a small-sized, high-speed memory located within the CPU or very close to it.
 
• It stores frequently accessed data and instructions to improve the **processing speed** of the CPU.
 
• Cache memory is faster than **RAM** and is used to reduce the time taken to access data from the main memory.
 
 
 
• **Control Unit (CU)**__
 __
 
• The **Control Unit** is one of the main components of the CPU and is responsible for directing the flow of data and instructions.
 
• It interprets program instructions and controls the operation of the CPU's other components, such as the **ALU** and memory.
 
• The CU is crucial for the execution of programs and ensures proper coordination between various parts of the computer.
 
 
 
• **Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU)**__
 
 
• The **Arithmetic Logic Unit** performs all the **arithmetic** (e.g., addition, subtraction) and **logical operations** (e.g., comparisons) required for processing data.
 
• The ALU is integral to the CPU and works closely with the **Control Unit** to execute instructions.
 
• It is a fundamental component for tasks that involve mathematical computations and decision-making processes.

questions.question: {If } a² + b² = 144, a times b = 24 { and } a > b, { then find the value of } (a -b)/(a + b).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The squared ratio of difference to sum is given by [(a² + b²) − 2ab] / [(a² + b²) + 2ab].

Substituting values: (144 − 48) / (144 + 48) = 96 / 192 = 1 / 2.

Taking square root on both sides: (a − b) / (a + b) = √(1 / 2).

**∴ The correct answer is sqrt(1)/(2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** a² + b² = 144, ab = 24, and a > b.

**Formula used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab and (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6fb3182f88e7102473b806661dec4cc66a2d12e22fdb3fc4d5a50cc2e6ed17b.png] 

⇒ First, calculate the **sum of squares** plus twice the **product**:

⇒ (a + b)² = 144 + 2 × 24 = 144 + 48 = 192

⇒ a + b = √192

⇒ Next, calculate the **sum of squares** minus twice the **product**:

⇒ (a − b)² = 144 − 2 × 24 = 144 − 48 = 96

⇒ a − b = √96

⇒ Now, find the required ratio of (a − b) to (a + b):

⇒ (a − b) / (a + b) = √96 / √192

⇒ (a − b) / (a + b) = √(96 / 192)

⇒ (a − b) / (a + b) = √(1 / 2)

**∴ The correct answer is sqrt(1)/(2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Binomial Expansion

The expansion (x ± y)² = x² + y² ± 2xy is a fundamental identity used to relate the sum and difference of squares with their products.

Relation between Sum and Difference

The difference between the squares of the sum and the difference of two numbers is (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab.

Properties of Square Roots

For any positive numbers x and y, the property √x / √y = √(x / y) allows for the simplification of ratios involving radicals.</p

Remove RNA primers from the lagging strand

__
 
• **DNA polymerase** is a key enzyme involved in the process of **DNA replication**.
 
• Its primary function is to **catalyse the addition of nucleotides** to the growing DNA strand, ensuring it is **complementary** to the original template strand.
 
• The enzyme works in the **5’ to 3’ direction**, adding new nucleotides to the **free 3’-OH group** of the preceding nucleotide.
 
• DNA polymerase requires a **template strand** and a **primer** to initiate synthesis.
 
• This enzyme plays a critical role in maintaining the **accuracy and fidelity** of DNA replication by performing **proofreading** and correcting errors.
 
• DNA polymerase is essential for **cell division** as it ensures that genetic information is accurately passed to daughter cells.
 
• Replication of DNA is crucial for processes such as **growth, repair, and reproduction** in living organisms.
 
• There are different types of DNA polymerase enzymes, including **DNA polymerase I, II, and III** in prokaryotes and **DNA polymerase alpha, beta, delta, and epsilon** in eukaryotes, each specialized for different functions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ligate Okazaki fragments together**__

 __
 
• This function is performed by the enzyme **DNA ligase**, not DNA polymerase.
 
• Okazaki fragments are short DNA sequences synthesized on the **lagging strand** during replication.
 
• DNA ligase joins these fragments by forming **phosphodiester bonds** between adjacent nucleotides.
 
 
 
• **Unwind the DNA double helix**__
 __
 
• This process is carried out by the enzyme **helicase**, not DNA polymerase.
 
• Helicase breaks the hydrogen bonds between complementary base pairs, allowing the two strands of DNA to separate and serve as templates.
 
 
 
• **Remove RNA primers from the lagging strand**__
 
 
• The removal of RNA primers is performed by enzymes such as **DNA polymerase I** in prokaryotes and **RNase H** in eukaryotes.
 
• DNA polymerase I also replaces the RNA primers with DNA nucleotides after their removal.

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ + 2(xy)² = 4624

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ + 2(16)² = 4624

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ + 2(256) = 4624

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ + 512 = 4624

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ = 4624 − 512 = 4112.

**∴ The correct answer is 4112.**

questions.question: If the ratio of two numbers is 3 : 16 and the product of their LCM and their HCF is 432, then the sum of the reciprocals of the LCM and the HCF is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **Ratio** = 3 : 16 and **Product (LCM × HCF)** = 432.

Let numbers be 3x and 16x. Then HCF = x and LCM = 3 × 16 × x = 48x.

Product: x × 48x = 432 ⇒ 48x² = 432 ⇒ x² = 9 ⇒ **x = 3**.

LCM = 48 × 3 = 144 and HCF = 3.

Sum of reciprocals = (1/144) + (1/3) = (1 + 48) / 144 = 49/144.

**∴ The correct answer is 49/144.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio = 3 : 16, Product of **LCM** and **HCF** = 432.

**Formula:** Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52bea6ebb11c9ad027f0b5a969550e968f70cd3688088c7e4e415995f061d444.png] 

⇒ Let the numbers be 3x and 16x.

⇒ Product of numbers = (3x) × (16x) = 432

⇒ 48x² = 432

⇒ x² = 432 ÷ 48 = 9

⇒ x = 3

⇒ **HCF** (highest common factor of 3x and 16x) = x = 3

⇒ **LCM** (least common multiple of 3x and 16x) = 48x = 48 × 3 = 144

⇒ Sum of reciprocals = (1/144) + (1/3)

⇒ Sum = (1 + 48) / 144 = 49/144

**∴ The correct answer is 49/144.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Relation

For any two numbers a and b, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: a × b = HCF(a,b) × LCM(a,b).

LCM and HCF of Fractions

HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators). LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators).

Ratio Property

If two numbers are in the ratio a : b (where a and b are co-prime), and their HCF is h, then the numbers are ah and bh, and their LCM is abh.</p
